entries.name: 妲兰
entries.look: 三十出头的女子，肩背箭囊，脸上有一道从眉到尾的旧痕；说话时手一直搭在弓弦上。
entries.voice: 低、稳、只讲事实；被夸就皱眉。
greetings: 你还在这一带。绳子带了吗？
夜里巢是静的。静的时候更危险。
chats: 羽毛值钱，是因为有人肯买。不是因为羽毛好。
它们记脸。你来过一次，它们就记住了。
我一个人来，是因为人多会吵。
site_lines: arrival
沿着我踩过的石头走，别抄近路。
warning
听见扑翅别跑，蹲下。跑才追你。
refusal
要我带你上崖？不带。上去了还得下来。
links: 空间_PAS_柏石关与关外聚落

before: 你身上有地窖的土味。先掸干净，崖上闻得出。
after: 地窖的事完了，崖上的巢还在。你要再来，绳子自己带。
early: 你先见的我，后下的窖。好，我说过的话你别改写。
late: 窖里的事完了才上崖？崖不认迟来的人，只认站得稳的。
proxy: 猎人不在崖下时，别替她数羽毛；巢自己会数。

english.greet.first: Don't look up. Look up and they move.
english.greet.revisit: Still in these parts. Did you bring rope?
english.greet.night: The nest is quiet at night. Quiet is worse.
english.chat.1: Feathers fetch a price because someone pays it, not because they're fine.
english.chat.2: They remember faces. Come once and you're remembered.
english.chat.3: I hunt alone because a crowd makes noise.
english.site.arrival: Follow the stones I stepped on. No shortcuts.
english.site.warning: Wings behind you - crouch, don't run. Running is what they chase.
english.site.refusal: Take you up the cliff? No. Up is easy; down is the problem.
english.visit.before: You smell of the cellar. Brush it off; the cliff can smell it.
english.visit.after: The cellar business is done; the nest is still there. Come again and bring your own rope.
english.visit.early: You met me before going down to the cellar. Good - don't rewrite what I said.
english.visit.late: The cellar first, the cliff second? Cliffs don't welcome latecomers; they test feet.
english.visit.proxy: Whenever the hunter is gone, don't count her feathers. The nest counts its own.

entries.name: 忒曼
entries.look: 五十来岁的男人，罩着补过的网面罩，臂上套着旧皮袖；身上总有股烟味。
entries.voice: 絮絮叨叨，爱打比方说蜂；谈到亡蜂巢就收起笑。
greetings: 站远些，你身上味道重，蜂不喜欢。
是你。烟还够，坐吧——别坐箱边。
夜里蜂归巢，人也该归。你不回村？
chats: 蜂认烟不认人。人认人，也得看烟——酒桌上那点烟。
田荒了蜂就散。散出去就不回来，跟人一样。
蜜卖不出去也得收。烂在箱里，明年就没有了。
site_lines: arrival
先闻闻风。风往哪边吹，你就站哪边。
warning
别拍。拍一下，整箱都出来。
refusal
要我去掏亡蜂巢？不去。那巢不是蜂丢的，是人丢的。

before: 空地的活计要是用火，先跟我说一声。烟一起，蜂就散。
after: 空地收拾完了。蜂认得烟，也认得收拾过地的人。
early: 你先来过我这儿，后去的空地。那烟的事你办得对。
late: 空地的事完了才来？蜂没怪你，我怪你晚。
proxy: 养蜂人不在时，蜂箱上的烟熏痕别擦；那是规矩。

english.greet.first: Stand back; you carry a strong scent and the bees dislike it.
english.greet.revisit: It's you. Smoke's still enough - sit, but not by the boxes.
english.greet.night: Bees go home at night; so should people. Not going back to the village?
english.chat.1: Bees know smoke, not faces. People know faces - and smoke too, the kind at a tavern table.
english.chat.2: When fields go fallow the swarm scatters. Scattered means gone, same as people.
english.chat.3: Honey that won't sell still gets taken in. Left rotting in the box, there's none next year.
english.site.arrival: Smell the wind first. Stand on the side it blows toward.
english.site.warning: Don't swat. One swat brings out the whole box.
english.site.refusal: Rob the dead hive for you? No. That hive wasn't lost by bees; it was lost by people.
english.visit.before: If the clearing work needs fire, tell me first. One smoke and the bees scatter.
english.visit.after: The clearing's done. Bees know smoke, and they know who tidied the ground.
english.visit.early: You came to me first, the clearing after. You handled the smoke right.
english.visit.late: The clearing's finished and now you remember me? The bees forgive you. I don't.
english.visit.proxy: If the beekeeper has gone, don't wipe the smoke marks off the hives. That's the rule.

entries.name: 珥兰
entries.look: 三十多岁的女子，腿绑皮护，腰后插着三根削尖的木桩；走路几乎不出声。
entries.voice: 几乎不说整句，先说“看脚下”；聊到猎物才多说两句。
greetings: 还是你。今天别往南走，南边有陷。
夜里草场是它们的。白天才是我的。
chats: 陷是木头做的，人心不是。
猎物多的时候，人会贪。贪了就不看脚下。
我不打幼的。打了明年吃什么。
site_lines: arrival
跟着我踩的地方走。多一步都不行。
warning
看见翻起的草皮就绕，那是新陷。
refusal
要我撤陷给你让路？不撤。绕两步的事。

before: 夜岗要用的陷，我按旧图摆。你改一根木桩，我就撤一片陷。
after: 夜岗安生了。陷还在草里，你自己记着位置，别怪我没喊。
early: 你先见的我，后去的夜岗。那旧图的事你对得上。
late: 夜岗的事完了才来找我？陷不等人，狼也不等。
proxy: 设陷的人不在草场时，翻起的草皮就是告示；别踩。

english.greet.revisit: Still you. Don't go south today; snares to the south.
english.greet.night: The meadow is theirs at night. The day is mine.
english.chat.1: Snares are made of wood. People aren't.
english.chat.2: When game is plenty, people get greedy. Greedy people stop watching their feet.
english.chat.3: I don't take the young. Take them and what do we eat next year?
english.site.arrival: Step where I stepped. Not one pace more.
english.site.warning: Turned turf means a new snare. Walk around it.
english.site.refusal: Pull my snares to clear your way? No. Two steps around it is all it takes.
english.visit.before: Snares for the night watch go by the old map. Move one stake and I pull a whole line.
english.visit.after: The night watch is quiet. The snares are still in the grass; remember where, and don't blame me for silence.
english.visit.early: You met me before the night watch. The old map will line up for you.
english.visit.late: The night watch is done and only now the snares? Snares keep their own time; so do wolves.
english.visit.proxy: Were the trapper gone from the meadow, turned turf is the notice. Don't step on it.

entries.name: 佴珥
entries.look: 三十多岁的男人，身上披着带毛的旧褂，腰后插一根削尖的短棍；说话时看兽道不看人。
entries.voice: 短句，先报兽的行踪再答问题；被夸就摆手。
greetings: 站到兽道侧面。站在道上，它先看见你。
还是你。今天兽道没新印。
夜里我守上半宿，下半宿归它。
chats: 骨堆不是它凶，是它按点吃。
人比兽难守。人换班不打招呼。
守望不是杀。先看清楚是几头。
site_lines: arrival
脚步压到最轻。兽道口回音大。
warning
新蹭的树皮别摸，手味留得久。
refusal
要我进洞赶它？不。赶了它改道，道就没了。

before: 夜岗要守，先看兽道。道上没新印，才算安稳。
after: 夜岗安生了。兽道还在，兽也还在，只是没过来。
early: 你先见过我，后去的夜岗。那几处新蹭的树皮你还记得。
late: 夜岗的事完了才来？兽道不等人，风也不等。
proxy: 守望的人不在时，新蹭的树皮就是告示；别摸。

english.greet.first: Stand off the trail. Stand on it and it sees you first.
english.greet.revisit: Still you. No fresh prints on the trail today.
english.greet.night: I keep the first half of the night; the second half is its.
english.chat.1: The bone pile isn't cruelty; it eats on schedule.
english.chat.2: People are harder to watch than beasts. They change shifts without telling you.
english.chat.3: Watching isn't killing. First count how many heads.
english.site.arrival: Keep your steps as light as you can. The trail head carries sound.
english.site.warning: Don't touch freshly rubbed bark. Hand smell lingers.
english.site.refusal: Drive it out of the cave? No. Drive it out and it changes trails, and the trail is gone.
english.visit.before: To hold the night watch, read the trail first. No fresh prints means a quiet night.
english.visit.after: The night watch is quiet. The trail is still there, and so is the beast; it just didn't come.
english.visit.early: Your first call was here, the night watch second. You still recall those rubbed trunks.
english.visit.late: The watch behind you, the trail now? Neither trail nor wind waits.
english.visit.proxy: When the watcher is away, freshly rubbed bark is the notice. Don't touch it.
